metaTitle: Favicon Generator - PNG Icons and favicon.ico (Free) | ReelFlow Toolkit
description: Turn an image or a letter into every favicon size from 16 to 512 pixels. Preview each icon, download the PNGs and a ready favicon.ico - no upload.
ogTitle: Favicon Generator - Every Icon Size From One Source
ogDescription: Make 16-512 px PNG favicons plus a favicon.ico from an image or a letter, right in your browser.
ldDescription: Generate favicon PNG files from 16 to 512 pixels and a multi-size favicon.ico from an uploaded image or a text glyph, entirely in the browser.
lede: Use an image or a letter to build every favicon size you need, preview them at real size, and download the PNGs plus a ready favicon.ico.

faq.a: 16, 32, 48, 64, 180 (Apple touch icon), 192 and 512 pixel squares, plus a favicon.ico that packs the 16, 32 and 48 pixel versions.

faq.q: Can I make an icon from text instead of an image?
faq.a: Yes. Pick one or two letters, choose a background and text colour, and the tool renders the same seven sizes. This is the quickest route for a new site.

faq.q: Does the source image get uploaded?
faq.a: No. The image is drawn to a canvas in your browser and every icon is generated locally. Nothing is sent to a server.
